facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance says the FOUTA online tax payment platform is being deployed in three phases, with a pilot phase engaged, large and medium enterprises next, and all taxpayers by the end of 2026.
The Ministry of Finance says the FOUTA pilot phase was engaged with a number of enterprises that already file returns electronically (telediclaration), with the declaration made on E-Tax.

The Ministry of Finance says taxes are paid online through FOUTA after declaration on E-Tax, by mobile money or bank transfer validated by OTP, with a signed electronic receipt, and a live payment demonstration was given on 3 July 2026 (pilot phase).

facts.fact: The ministry says e-Tax, run by the tax directorate, is the online filing and payment system for domestic taxes, and it brought in 94 billion FCFA via Fouta from June to 16 November 2026.
The ministry says taxes are paid online through e-Tax, with 94 billion FCFA collected via Fouta by 16 November 2026.
Yoka said FCFA 94 billion of tax revenue was collected through e-Tax via the FOUTA payment platform between 1 June and 16 November 2026.
